C was excised by owner ruling (2026-08-09, re-affirmed 2026-08-15 and 2026-08-26); this artifact is retained because 10 consumers read it, including the L2 dashboard per_observable_100x_status.py. caveats: Q_β / m_n / Δ_pn rows: these figures were built in Markov convention C (z = √q/(q+1)), which the owner ruling of 2026-08-15 excised in favour of the canonical D (z = q³/(q²+1)). The upstream qbeta-ck-cache.witness.json carries that stamp; this dashboard published the numbers without it, which is the defect being fixed here (bean qou-zzwm). NO induced-error figure is given, deliberately: qbeta_ck_cache.py raises SystemExit(2) under D, so no D-frame counterpart exists to difference against and any number here would be manufactured. These figures are therefore UNREPRODUCIBLE under the canonical convention. Re-derivation is bean qou-cds1 and is NOT a z-swap — the 2026-08-30 bar-weight prune showed the obstruction is the offset (α = (z−1)h/2 mixes bar-weight −4 with weight 0), not z. This caveat makes the inherited frame visible; it does not change any value.
